t: This is Berkeley Street, in the City of Westminster. It's named after John Berkeley, 1st Baron Berkeley of Stratton, who lived from 1602 to 1678. He was an English royalist soldier, politician and diplomat, closely associated with James, Duke of York, from 1648. His title refers to the Battle of Stratton in Cornwall in 1643, where the Royalists destroyed Parliament's field army in Devon and Cornwall. Together with Sir George Carteret, he also founded the Province of New Jersey, the colony that became the American state.
